reviews.comment: Dr. Cizmas was one of the hardest yet best professors I have taken so far. While his class was insanely difficult, it was enjoyable. He and his TA were more than willing to help you out on a homework problem or with the theory based question even if it wasn't during office hours. Exam Q's came right from textbook so study those for the exams.
He just reads the textbook. All homework and exam questions come from the textbook. I just went to his class so he could read for me. If you can read on your own, don't go to lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Hard but rewarding class, knew no Fortran before, and can say I am confident in it now. Lectures can be heavy and confusing, but you can tell he enjoys this subject and recognizes it is difficult. Get to know him, and he is a good guy who cares.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Horrendous professor. If you wish to learn more about CFD you will have more luck and progress by self teaching through a textbook or online courses. This course taught me nothing about CFD and the theory behind it rather how to please his ego. The final exam is oral and picks obscure topics from the far reaches of the quasi-textbook.

I submitted an updated Euler Solver at the end of the semester and asked Dr. Cizmas to regrade it. He initially told me everything looked fine. Weeks later, I followed up and found out he hadn't actually reviewed my submission - and said it was too late to update my grade. This was frustrating and felt dismissive of my effort.

2 projects worth 40%, hw worth 20%. Do well on the hw, as we only had 2. The projects are difficult, and we cover all the necessary material to complete them within 2 months. The only reason to go to class afterwards is that if you get below an 80, you have to take an awful oral exam. Lots of work and stress but I learned the material I guess
Most of the class is spent reviewing old material. However, the grading standards are unreasonably high.

He is absolutely the funniest man I have ever met. He expected us to memorize every single part of his textbook and if we did not we would fail the exam. 66/189 people failed this class and he believed this to be acceptable. I found this very funny. If you have the unfortunate pleasure to take him, good luck! It is an experience that is for sure.

Dr. Cizmas' lectures can be hard to follow and extremely boring, aside from some of his great jokes,but his textbook is a godsend. Homework is a participation grade save a few assignments, but still be sure to do it! Homework, quiz and exam problems are for the most part straight from the textbook. Know the textbook and you'll do great.
